name: Sparse Representation (Dictionary Based)
definition: A method where each block of size m = M^3 is mapped to a column vector y. A sparse representation of y with at most S entries is found by solving an optimization problem using a dictionary D.
summary: Sparse Representation (Dictionary Based) encodes volume data using sparse linear combinations of dictionary atoms, offering higher fidelity than Vector Quantization at the cost of significantly more complex encoding.
